'''Steak''' was a class of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] eaten in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Varieties of steak included [[Quor'sav-fried steak]]<ref name="DaD">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref> and [[thookah-steak]].<ref name="SOR4">[[Droids (1995) 8|''Droids'' (1995) 8]]</ref>
